defs.def: to damage sth so badly that it no longer exists, works, etc. 摧毁；毁灭；破坏

ex.s: Yet while an Innovator creates something new, the Disruptor is defined as much by what they destroy as by what they create.
ex.t: 颠覆者推动变革；收拾烂摊子是别人的事。

ex.s: Whole neighbourhoods were destroyed to make way for new road networks and kids had to play elsewhere.
ex.t: "我没做，先生，"我争辩道，但他眼中满是____怀疑。

ex.s: Hence this book, Chasing the Sea: Lost Among the Ghosts of Empire in Central Asia, which talks about a road trip from Tashkent to Karakalpakstan, where millions of lives have been destroyed by the slow drying up of the sea.
ex.t: 于是就有了这本书《追逐大海：在中亚帝国幽灵中迷失》书中讲述了从塔什干到卡拉卡尔帕克斯坦的公路旅行在那里数百万人的生活因咸海缓慢干涸而被摧毁。

ex.s: “It sounds crazy to talk about guilt-free fur-unless you understand that the nutria are destroying vast wetlands every year”, says Cree McCree, project director of Righteous Fur.
ex.t: "谈论无内疚感的毛皮听起来很疯狂——除非你明白海狸鼠每年都在破坏大片湿地，"Righteous Fur项目负责人Cree McCree说。

ex.s: By the time she was 13，her company was worth millions of dollars with the invention of a super-sweet treat that could save kids' teeth，instead of destroying them.

defs.def: to kill an animal deliberately, usually because it is sick or not wanted （因动物有病或不再需要而）杀死，消灭，人道毁灭

ex.s: In many of the places where the butterfly can be found, people are destroying the natural environment.
ex.t: 在这种蝴蝶分布的许多地方，人们正在破坏其自然环境。

ex.s: When a house is destroyed by fire, you can say "it burns up", and you can also say "it burns down".
ex.t: 当一座房子被火烧毁时，你可以说"it burns up"，你也可以说"it burns down"。

ex.s: Caused by exceptionally heavy snowfall within a short period of time, they destroyed buildings and forest, and claimed over 256 lives.
ex.t: 由于短时间内异常大的降雪量，它们摧毁了建筑物和森林，夺走了超过256条生命。

ex.s: When the ice did begin to melt, it started to destroy the ship, leaving the men with no other choice but to set up camp on the ice.
ex.t: 当冰层真正开始融化时，它开始摧毁船只，使人们别无选择，只能在冰上扎营。

ex.s: Feeling desperate, he tries to destroy the portrait with a knife, but it is he who is killed.
ex.t: 绝望中，他试图用小刀毁掉那幅画像，但最终被杀死的却是他自己。
